# Description of the study
## Brief Summary
The VITamin D and OmegA-3 TriaL (VITAL) is a randomized clinical trial in 25,871 U.S. men and women investigating whether taking daily dietary supplements of vitamin D3 (2000 IU) or omega-3 fatty acids (Omacor® fish oil, 1 gram)reduces the risk of developing cancer, heart disease, and stroke in people who do not have a prior history of these illnesses. The 5-year intervention phase (study pill-taking, median 5.3 years) has ended; post-intervention observational follow-up of study participants is ongoing.

1. Study Type:	
Interventional  (Clinical Trial)

2. Actual Enrollment:
25871 participants

3. Allocation:
Randomized

4. Intervention Model:
Factorial Assignment

5. Masking:
Triple (Participant, Investigator, Outcomes Assessor)

6. Primary Purpose:
Prevention

7. Official Title:
Vitamin D and Omega-3 Trial (VITAL)

8. Study Start Date:
July 2010

9. Intervention/treatment : 

Dietary Supplement: vitamin D3

Drug: omega-3 fatty acids (fish oil)

Dietary Supplement: Vitamin D3 placebo

Dietary Supplement: Fish oil placebo

10. Phase:
Phase 3



# Exploratory analysis

**1. prepare the packages**
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(patchwork)
library(haven)
library(bis620)

```

**2. import the data**
```{r}
# read the raw data
data(rawdata)


# select needed variables
data <- rawdata[c("sex", "vitdactive", "fishoilactive", "mideath", "stdeath", "cvdeath", "chdeath")] %>% 
  tibble::as_tibble()
```

**3. clean the data**
```{r}
# group the data into four treatments
groupdata <- aggregate(cbind(mideath, stdeath, cvdeath, chdeath) ~ vitdactive + fishoilactive, data, sum) 


# transform wider data to longer data
data_longer <- groupdata %>% 
  pivot_longer(contains("death"),
               names_to = "death",
               values_to = "count")


# count the death from different treatments
mydata <- data_longer %>% 
  mutate(group=paste(vitdactive, fishoilactive, sep = "_"))


# reorder the columns of dataset
mydata <- mydata %>% select(group, death, count)

```

**4. visulize the data**
```{r}
# using ggplot to plot stacked bar graph
p1 <- ggplot(mydata, aes(group,count,fill=death))+
  geom_col()+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("PLACEBO VD + PLACEBO O3",
                              "PLACEBO VD + ACTIVE O3",
                              "ACTIVE VD + PLACEBO O3",
                              "ACTIVE VD + ACTIVE O3")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=rel(0.8), angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))+
  ylim(0, 150)+
  ggtitle("Stacked Bar Graph")


# using ggplot to plot clustered bar graph
p2 <- ggplot(mydata, aes(group,count,fill=death))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity",position="dodge")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Accent")+
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("PLACEBO VD + PLACEBO O3",
                              "PLACEBO VD + ACTIVE O3",
                              "ACTIVE VD + PLACEBO O3",
                              "ACTIVE VD + ACTIVE O3")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size=rel(0.8),angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))+
  ylim(0, 100)+
  ggtitle("Clusted Bar Graph")


# put two pictures together
p1/p2
```



# Create a hypothesis and plan for testing
Hypothesis:vitamin D3 and omega-3 fatty acids would significantly affect the death count of people.

*There is no difference between groups*


# Test the hypothesis

```{r}
# Homogeneity of variance test-Bartlett test
bartlett.test(count ~ vitdactive, data=data_longer)
bartlett.test(count ~ fishoilactive, data=data_longer)


# Two-way ANOVA hypotheses
summary(aov(count ~ vitdactive * fishoilactive, data=data_longer))


# plot the results
library(HH)

interaction2wt(count ~ vitdactive * fishoilactive, data=data_longer)
```
